value.title: Small Three
value.synopsis: Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame — the Small 3 — load up an odd disc from their teacher. When they're not looking, Pyontaro's little sister Futaba vanishes.

value.title: Multiverse
value.synopsis: Stranded in a new world, the Small 3 realize they have incredible powers. They meet other versions of themselves and learn how this reality differs.

value.title: Aliens
value.synopsis: Futaba's abductors subject her to tests, but she just wants her big bwudder. The Small 3 continue the search for Futaba and encounter a tense standoff.

value.title: Mr. Segami
value.synopsis: As college student Segami struggles with his dystopian world, a hot schoolmate hands him an enticing flyer. Hoping to meet girls, he finds something else.

value.title: Rebellion
value.synopsis: With his mind in a whirl, Segami runs into the Small 3. They witness a bold fighter pilot pit his life against an alien ship. Will it light a fire?

value.title: Game On!
value.synopsis: The Rebellion announces a guerrilla attack in Shibuya and Segami resolves to join. Meanwhile, a distraught Futaba stumbles upon a furry winged creature.

value.title: Counterattack
value.synopsis: Aliens surround a sleeping Futaba! In Shibuya, Segami and his comrades fight fiercely but lose ground. As he retreats, he spots Tashiro under attack.

value.title: The Strangers
value.synopsis: Futaba faces off against a squad of alien soldiers to protect her new friend. Facing heavy losses, Segami and the Rebellion turn to their secret weapon.

value.title: The Strong Men
value.synopsis: Genius commandeers an alien walker and leads a counterattack. But two fearsome alien soldiers are en route. Meanwhile, Doc and the others seek answers.

value.title: Time Is Up
value.synopsis: As the Small 3 soar toward Shibuya, Genius runs out of options against a relentless alien warrior. Reinforcements arrive — but will it be enough?

value.title: We Are "Thunder 3"!!
value.synopsis: The "Small Three" arrive as live-streamed reinforcements to battle alien invaders, save Futaba, and officially debut as "THUNDER 3".

value.title: Final Attack
value.synopsis: The cry rings out around the world for the Thunder 3!  Humanity's last hope and their saviors against the aliens!
